sloka: मन्त्रिणां वचनं श्रुत्वा यथाभिलषितं प्रियम् ।अब्रवीत्सारथिं वाक्यं रथो मे युज्यतामिति ॥ २.११५.७॥
transliteration: mantriṇāṁ vacanaṁ śrutvā yathābhilaṣitaṁ priyam ।abravītsārathiṁ vākyaṁ ratho me yujyatāmiti ॥ 2.115.7॥

translations.english: On hearing the pleasing words of the counsellors which were in conformity with his desire, Bharata said to his charioteer, 'Harness my chariot'.
